results.name: The canvas has the whole page: no title row, breadcrumb or toolbar row above it, only floating controls
One block sits in the middle and the other eight branch out around it, joined by arrows, none overlapping
Every AI block shows its real brand mark and its role
Pan and zoom: dragging the background pans, the buttons and Ctrl+wheel zoom, Fit brings the whole map back
Opening a block shows its settings in a floating panel; editing the name updates the block and is saved and restored
The role is the person's choice and changes the block's label and default instructions
The AI block is the person's choice: Kimi, Ollama, Gemini, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, a person; a local model is typed
Tools, approval and limits are attributes of the block
"Add block" connects a new block of the chosen role to the selected block; it is selected, named and joined
The + handles on the selected block add a block on that side
Dragging a block moves it, it keeps the place after a reload, and "Tidy up" gives it back to the layout
Arrow keys nudge the focused block and Delete asks before removing it; undo brings it back
The Tree view shows the same blocks as a tree and the toggle returns to the map
Running on the map: arrows animate, the writer needs approval, the tester fails once and is retried, the run ends done
Clear returns every block to ready; Stop ends a run and the clock stops
A run survives a reload; the structure is frozen while it is active
Run from here starts one block and what hangs under it
Process settings: goal, cost unit, tidy, export and import; the engine dialog explains how to connect
A local-model template lays out Hermes Agent, two Ollama blocks and a person, and says what still needs choosing
The library lists, switches, duplicates and deletes processes (with confirmation and undo)
Every arrow starts and ends exactly on the side of its block, before a run, during it and after adding blocks (no gap on the way down)
Roles: QA, Creator and Reviewer join the others; each role explains itself and offers the sub-blocks and the next role that usually go with it
Every AI agent has a logo and can be chosen: the picker is grouped, searchable and lists more than ninety engines
The person draws the connections: from Fixer back to Coordinator makes a loop with rounds, a label and a card; undo removes it
A connection that is not allowed says why; a block can be connected to any other, and the inspector lists and removes connections
Deleting a block takes its connections with it; moving a block under another can drop a connection that is no longer allowed
The closed-loop template: the deploy asks, and after the person approves the loop goes round and asks again; the cards say which round
Phone: no horizontal overflow, blocks are readable, the dock fits and the settings open as a sheet
Phone: a finger drags the background to pan and a block to move it; two fingers pinch to zoom
Phone: the run can be started and decided without leaving the page
WebKit: the map draws with its arrows, a block is edited and a run reaches the approval
REST: the engine chip says connected, the engine's installed models are offered and processes save with versions
REST: a run is started on the server; its snapshots, approval and result are shown; decisions are sent as actions
REST: a refused save shows its message and keeps the edit; Retry saves again; a conflict offers Reload
No page errors and nothing was requested from another origin
